purpose: One contract, two implementations. The research screen (#151) has to render every state the run API can be in, including the ones nobody demonstrates: queued, running, failed, a completed run whose leakage check went red, and a run with no explanation graph. These payloads come from a real `research_engine.cli smoke` run rather than being written by hand, so a schema change breaks the fixture instead of leaving the screen rendering a shape the backend no longer produces.
notes: Generated by running the CI configuration and trimming to one scenario. Regenerate rather than editing by hand.
`succeeded_with_failed_check` is the same report with one leakage check flipped to false. It exists so the screen is tested on the case it matters most for.
Numbers here are from a deliberately short configuration and are not a statement about model performance.
